limits: Metalness 0.90 is an editorial mixed-surface starting value, not an alloy identifier, coating measurement or final-built certification. Do not call it stainless steel, aluminium, anodized or powder coated.
Do not sharpen or add brushing anisotropy: verified UVs do not establish a brushing direction.

The published derivative is a single merged primitive. This plan is a neutral whole-scheme finish, not a verified per-component material schedule. Do not infer panel/core/base materials by triangle position. A future multi-material split needs recorded source-object ranges and separate review without changing original geometry buffers.

displayAdaptation.materialPolicy: Preserve all original Points and positions; use a two-pixel unlit explanatory graphic. No fabricated surface, tube or physical TPU material.
displayAdaptation.sourcePreservation: Original transforms, positions, normals, UVs, indices, source-file revision, topology and complete first-draw coverage remain unchanged.
limits: Unlit points do not possess a PBR material response. Do not convert them into spheres, tubes, surfaces or a skin to imitate TPU.
The colour is an explicitly explanatory graphic choice, not a sampled material reflectance or physical process measurement.
Do not reduce/drop points or lower their opacity until they falsely look like a continuous solid. The original positions/counts/primitive remain exact.

processing.method: Original complete shade exported by Blender 4.0.2 glTF exporter; original node transform, normal/UV seams and exported material retained. Exact raw buffer compression. The original procedural shader and IOR graph are not equivalent to the glTF material; this is not a new optical simulation.

displayAdaptation.adapter: Project-local static material and lighting presentation; no geometry/source-asset rewrite.
displayAdaptation.materialPolicy: Clone and preserve every native exported physical-material field; only correct the recorded source IOR scalar to 1.5700000524520874. This is not the complete linked Blender shader.

material.class: Preserve native MeshPhysicalMaterial (clone only if resource ownership requires)

environment.ownership: One baked target per project resource; retained while off chapter or suspended, released on true disposal. No new render loop or HDR download.

displayAdaptation.sourcePreservation: Original transforms, positions, normals, UVs, indices, source-file revision, topology and complete first-draw coverage remain unchanged.
limits: Three transmission samples the WebGL opaque framebuffer. The separate CSS/Canvas2D site field is not part of that texture and cannot be optically refracted by setting transmission/IOR alone. Environment reflection improves recognisability without claiming CSS-field refraction.

No caustic projection, multiple scattering, full Blender shader/lighting match, ray-dependent IOR, optical correctness or photographed-pixel equivalence is claimed. Do not draw an invented caustic light pool.
No procedural Noise/Bump port in the first adapter. The existing complete geometry already contains fine authored surface relief; keep POSITION/NORMAL/UV/index buffers unchanged.

Current source-native receipt omits Value-node output, ColorRamp elements, some socket data types/identifiers and relevant node modes. Input dictionaries keyed only by duplicated socket names do not establish the complete evaluated procedural graph.
